purpose: A shimmer headline for a website: a single highlight band sweeps across the heading once, when it first scrolls into view, and then it is plain text again.
namedChanges: The site's `--brand-fg`, `--brand-bg` and `--palette-goldBright` are the library's `--site-block-fg`, `--site-block-bg` and the new `--site-block-shimmer` (fallback the library accent, `--site-block-accent`, then `#2563eb`); the source's gold `#e7b339` is what its site maps `--site-block-shimmer` to.

Classes and keyframes are `sh`, `sh--dark`, `sh--sweeping` and `sh-sweep` (the source: `mj-shimmer`, `is-dark`, `is-sweeping`, `mj-shimmer-sweep`); the `animationend` filter matches `sh-sweep` by part, as the source did for its name.
Props are declared inline with `withDefaults` (same names and defaults).
